SPI for screen + touch SCK, MOSI, MISO: SD card SCK, MOSI, MISO, CS

Connect directly to the S pins of the expansion board, not through the breadboard: SD_SCK → IO39, SD_MOSI → IO40, SD_MISO → IO41, SD_CS → IO21. The SD card deliberately gets its own bus, separate from the screen and touch: an SD card that is not ready yet can disturb a shared bus, which makes the SD sometimes go undetected.

SD fails after moving the bus: at power-on, the robot_otak Serial Monitor prints a pin test for SD_SCK, SD_MOSI, SD_MISO. ok or ditarik ke 3,3 V is normal (some modules have pull-up resistors). If it says TERHUBUNG KE GND, the wire is in the wrong place.

This guide used to connect SD_SCK, SD_MOSI, and SD_MISO to columns 2, 5, and 8 (d2, d5, d8). If your build is still wired that way, pull those three wires out of the breadboard and move them to IO39, IO40, IO41. The screen and touch wires in columns 2, 5, 8 stay. After moving the wires, switch the robot off completely: unplug USB, turn off the switch, wait 10 seconds. The RST button and uploading do not power off the SD card, and a card that got stuck only recovers once its power is really cut.
